description: Third-party dependency license policy for Zentro. The core is licensed GPL-3.0-only; third-party code under strong copyleft licenses is incompatible and must be rejected unless an owner-approved exception is recorded.

exceptions.reason: go-licenses cannot auto-detect this module's BSD-3-Clause LICENSE file. The file was reviewed manually and matches the standard BSD-3-Clause text.

pro.note: This directory will hold closed-source code. It does not exist yet. When it is added, no third-party copyleft license is permitted there, including weak file-level copyleft such as MPL-2.0: only permissive licenses may be used, because the closed-source Pro code can only be combined with GPL code that Zentro itself owns.
